verdict.rationale: Gitea documents its own API, which it says can extend functionality and build custom workflows. An official go-sdk, the tea CLI and an official MCP server are all built on top of it, so programmatic access is real first-party capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI does, and the OpenAPI/Swagger spec probes at the docs site all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of UI-to-API feature parity, a discoverable published API spec/reference, coverage of specific areas (issues, PR review, packages, Actions, admin config) via API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
